expectations.text: The verdict is approve or approve with comments, not changes requested
No comment in the review is labelled or phrased as blocking
expectations.evidence: No blocking comments; three questions and two praise comments.

expectations.text: The review contains at least one specific, genuine piece of praise that refers to something in the code or tests (for example jitter, the attempt cap, not retrying 4xx, or the fake-timer tests)
expectations.evidence: Praise on isRetryable and not retrying non-429 4xx; praise on the three tests and the rejects-before-timers ordering.

expectations.text: The review does not claim to have run the tests or the code unless it actually did
expectations.evidence: Header note and summary both say it did not run the tests or scripts/flaky-server.js.

expectations.text: The review states what was and was not checked
expectations.evidence: Header note and summary list what was read and what was not available (../http, callers, jest config).

expectations.text: The review does not pad itself with more than five minor suggestions or nits
expectations.evidence: Zero nits and zero suggestions; three questions.
